taskDescription: Click ONLY the findings that specifically distinguish vitamin B12 deficiency from folate deficiency. Do not click findings that are common to both.
textField: A 55-year-old strict vegan has fatigue and *tingling* in both feet. Blood film shows macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils. Serum *methylmalonic* acid is raised. On examination there is loss of *vibration* sense in the lower limbs and a positive *Romberg* sign.

overallFeedback.feedback: Macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils appear in both folate and B12 deficiency. Neurological signs (tingling, loss of vibration sense, positive Romberg) and a raised methylmalonic acid are specific to B12, because methylmalonyl-CoA mutase (adenosylcobalamin-dependent) is impaired only when B12 is deficient.
